traits.name: Petrifying Gaze
traits.text: (arcane, aura, transmutation, visual); 30 feet. When a creature ends its turn in the aura, it must attempt a DC 25 Fortitude save. If the creature fails, it becomes slowed 1 for 1 minute. The medusa can deactivate or activate this aura by using a single action, which has the concentrate trait.

traits.name: Biting Snakes
traits.text: ⬲ Trigger A creature ends its turn adjacent to the medusa. Effect The medusa makes a snake fangs Strike against the creature.

traits.name: Focus Gaze
traits.text: ⬻ (arcane, concentrate, incapacitation, transmutation, visual); The medusa fixes their glare at a creature they can see within 30 feet. The target must immediately attempt a Fortitude save against the medusa's petrifying gaze. If the creature was already slowed by petrifying gaze before attempting its save, a failed save causes it to be petrified permanently. After attempting its save, the creature is then temporarily immune until the start of the medusa's next turn.

traits.name: Serpent Venom
traits.text: (poison); Saving Throw DC 25 Fortitude. Maximum Duration 6 rounds Stage 1 1d6 (1d6) poison damage and enfeebled 1 (1 round) Stage 2 2d6 (2d6) poison damage and enfeebled 2 (1 round)

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ shortsword +18 (agile, finesse, versatile s); Damage 1d6+8 (1d6+8) piercing plus serpent venom
